what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia living in Malaysia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 63 Cambodian refugees in Malaysia, 0.6% of all refugees from Cambodia.
France hosts the most Cambodian refugees, followed by Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1972 to 1975 and from 1978 to 1998, with the KR among the opponents.
The main year of displacement in the data, 1985, falls within the second period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1977 at 1580 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6850, at the end of 1985, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malaysia.
These are year-end totals for Malaysia only, reported to UNHCR.
